scenario_label: Illustrative 6-day workweek only; original P6 template durations, not approved site dates

core_checks.title: Check current approved scope and drawing revision
core_checks.help: Record approved drawing/scope reference and any unresolved changes.

core_checks.title: Confirm predecessor work and outstanding holds
core_checks.help: Verify necessary prior inspection, access and engineering release.

core_checks.title: Brief responsible crew and confirm work method
core_checks.help: Record supervisor, team, work area, work method and safe access.

core_checks.title: Confirm materials, tools and equipment are available
core_checks.help: Check actual quantities and equipment against approved plan.

core_checks.title: Report activity-specific field execution and quantities
core_checks.help: Enter observed location, grid, quantities and supporting reference.

core_checks.title: Complete quality/safety checks and evidence references
core_checks.help: Site-report completion alone cannot certify acceptance or safety.

core_checks.title: Record handoff, defects and authorized disposition
core_checks.help: Handover requires the appropriate responsible person's acceptance.

1000.title: Planning and roles
checks: Confirm responsible site and management contacts
Confirm project-specific construction milestones and records register

2000.title: Design and drawings
checks: Identify effective drawing revision and interfaces
Record consultant clarification and revisions required

3000.title: Regulatory controls
checks: Verify statutory submissions and actual permit document
Track authority review, conditions and approved status

4000.title: Site readiness
checks: Confirm site limits, benchmark and setting-out evidence
Check excavation boundaries, access, utilities and safety readiness

5000.title: Substructure
checks: Identify footing or foundation grid and inspection requirements
Record concrete/rebar/formwork evidence and engineering hold clearance

6000.title: Superstructure
checks: Identify level, member and structural drawing reference
Record reinforcement/formwork checks before authorized pour

7000.title: Envelope
checks: Locate elevation and weatherproofing interface
Track mock-up, substrate acceptance and water ingress checks

8000.title: MEP
checks: Identify service route and structural clashes
Confirm required pre-closure inspections, tests and as-built evidence

9000.title: Interior fit-out
checks: Verify room/finish schedules and preceding wet-work
Track setting-out, substrate conditions and finish quality

10000.title: Commissioning and handover
checks: Collect test certificates, punch list and closeout references
Confirm training, handover documents and signed acceptance

1000.goal: Define work scope and responsibilities before scheduling construction.
1000.leads: Project manager, site engineer, discipline leads.
1000.prepare: Confirm project identity and the current document register.
1000.execute: Record dependencies, deliverables, decisions and unresolved issues.
1000.inspect: Planning records are not an authorization to start physical work.
1000.evidence: Dated scope references, decisions, responsible persons and open items.

2000.goal: Coordinate an effective reviewed design revision for the work.
2000.leads: Architect, structural and MEP designers; document controller.
2000.prepare: Identify level, block, drawing sheet, revision and interfaces.
2000.execute: Review discipline clashes and submit clarifications through the approved channel.
2000.inspect: Draft or superseded drawings cannot authorize construction.
2000.evidence: Drawing revisions, review log and authorized issue status.

3000.goal: Verify applicable statutory permission and its actual scope.
3000.leads: Project manager, permit controller and relevant authority.
3000.prepare: Locate current applications, conditions and controlled submissions.
3000.execute: Record actual replies, revisions and outstanding conditions.
3000.inspect: A construction-phase label or MCQ answer does not prove a permit.
3000.evidence: Issuing authority, approval ID, date, conditions and drawing revision.

4000.goal: Prepare access, benchmarks, grids and verified work boundaries.
4000.leads: Site engineer, surveyor, supervisor and safety lead.
4000.prepare: Confirm survey datum, utilities, site limits and approved plan.
4000.execute: Check offsets, levels, alignment and field access before execution.
4000.inspect: Do not excavate or set out from assumed dimensions.
4000.evidence: Benchmark and grid records, dated photos and discrepancy disposition.

5000.goal: Control below-ground work and interfaces before they are concealed.
5000.leads: Site engineer, structural engineer, foreman, service coordinator.
5000.prepare: Identify grid, approved member detail, base condition and inspection holds.
5000.execute: Stage reinforcement, formwork, services and approved sequence before closure.
5000.inspect: Concrete, backfill and closure need relevant inspections and hold release.
5000.evidence: Grid-tagged photos, material/test records and engineer dispositions.

6000.goal: Sequence structural frame members by approved level and stage.
6000.leads: Structural engineer, site supervisor, formwork and rebar crews.
6000.prepare: Confirm members, drawings, stability and prior inspection records.
6000.execute: Coordinate setting out, reinforcement, formwork and embeds before placing.
6000.inspect: Structural QA and temporary stability need responsible review.
6000.evidence: Member/grid records, pre-pour checks and concrete tests.

7000.goal: Protect exterior envelope continuity and weatherproof interfaces.
7000.leads: Site engineer, envelope contractor, design and QA leads.
7000.prepare: Confirm elevation, drainage, substrate and approved material system.
7000.execute: Coordinate openings, weatherproofing, interfaces and mock-ups.
7000.inspect: Check water ingress and concealed interface acceptance.
7000.evidence: Elevation photos, test results, products and defect closeout.

8000.goal: Coordinate service routes and tests before concealment.
8000.leads: MEP coordinator, trade supervisor, structural engineer for penetrations.
8000.prepare: Identify approved routes, equipment and member restrictions.
8000.execute: Arrange sleeves, access and tests without uncontrolled structural alteration.
8000.inspect: Unreviewed member drilling or cutting must not proceed.
8000.evidence: As-built route references, test sheets and clash disposition.

9000.goal: Start finishes only after substrates and preceding trades are ready.
9000.leads: Site engineer, finishing and QA supervisors, MEP coordinator.
9000.prepare: Verify room schedule, levels, moisture condition and mock-up.
9000.execute: Sequence finishes while protecting adjacent work and access.
9000.inspect: Inspect workmanship against the effective approved specification.
9000.evidence: Room IDs, batch records, photos and snag closeout.

10000.goal: Collect tested results and accountable handover documents.
10000.leads: Project manager, commissioning lead, engineers, client representative.
10000.prepare: Gather test plan, certificates, record drawings and defects.
10000.execute: Commission approved systems and track defects through closeout.
10000.inspect: MCQ reports do not constitute signed handover acceptance.
10000.evidence: Test certificates, warranties, training record and signed handover.

T5030.goal: Footing RCC is a grid-level work package; past footing reports are partial observations, not whole-activity completion.
T5030.leads: Site engineer, structural engineer, concrete/rebar foremen and plumbing coordinator.
T5030.prepare: Check footing/grid identity, foundation revision, CF1/C4, shear-key, substrate and all current holds.
T5030.execute: Arrange reinforcement cover, formwork, clean base and sleeves; request pre-pour inspection before any authorized placing.
T5030.inspect: Masonry-column interfaces, foundation detailing and plumbing-before-closure holds need responsible engineer disposition.
T5030.evidence: Dated grid, drawing revision, pre-pour photos, concrete tests, signed inspection and quantity reconciliation.

T8020.goal: Map plumbing routes before closure without assuming that reported coordination means installed pipework.
T8020.leads: Plumbing supervisor, site engineer and structural engineer at member crossings.
T8020.prepare: Confirm two unresolved locations, pipe purposes, diameters, levels and structural interfaces.
T8020.execute: Survey accessible routes and coordinate sleeves before tie-beam closure; no unauthorized drilling.
T8020.inspect: Plumbing and structural clash disposition remains unverified until documented.
T8020.evidence: Route sketch, grid/location, photos, inspection outcome and test record.

T4030.goal: Check building setting-out against controlled geometry in existing and proposed areas.
T4030.leads: Surveyor, site engineer and design lead for discrepancies.
T4030.prepare: Find effective block, benchmark, grid datum and drawing revision.
T4030.execute: Cross-check control points, alignments and levels before transferring set-out.
T4030.inspect: Assumed dimensions and unsettled CF1/C4 details are not acceptable field releases.
T4030.evidence: Dated set-out sketch, grid readings, revisions and disposition.

T3040.goal: Verify the statutory permit actually issued for the relevant work package.
T3040.leads: Authorized project/permit controller and issuing authority.
T3040.prepare: Find current permit document, conditions and approved drawing revision.
T3040.execute: Reconcile missing documents and conditions through the formal channel.
T3040.inspect: The project operates in Construction stage but building permit clearance is not yet verified.
T3040.evidence: Permit number, issuing authority, issue date, scope and drawing reference.

T2050.goal: Maintain effective construction drawing packages for existing versus proposed building scopes.
T2050.leads: Architect, structural and MEP consultants; document controller.
T2050.prepare: Identify the block, discipline, drawing revision and conflict log.
T2050.execute: Resolve coordinated interfaces and release status before transmitting site documents.
T2050.inspect: The generic master WBS is not an approved block-by-block drawing release.
T2050.evidence: Discipline drawing register, revision history and authorized issue record.
